## Why this matters
PR #397 was merged to `main` on 2026-06-14 without closing its R81 audit findings. This issue tracks the outstanding follow-up work. Feature is behind `FEATURE_COMMUNITY_VOICE_NOTES` (default-OFF) so there is no production blast radius today, but the PR is not R81-clean and cannot be flag-flipped until findings are closed.

## What's required
- [ ] **F1 (P2)** Read routes `list` and `getOne` mint signed download URLs per row but have no explicit `@Throttle` — `src/community/voice/community-voice.controller.ts:52-135` — fix: add explicit `@Throttle` metadata to both GET routes or cap/memoize signed-download minting; add metadata regression pin
- [ ] **F2 (P3)** `community-voice.e2e.spec.ts` is reflection-only, not a real HTTP integration test — `test/community/voice/community-voice.e2e.spec.ts` — fix: add a thin `supertest`/Nest HTTP integration test for the voice-note request path, or rename the file to remove the false e2e signal and add a true e2e test
- [ ] **N1 (P2)** Unfixed PR397 follow-up work lacks a durable R82 tracking issue — GitHub issue tracker — fix: this issue (self-referential; resolved by filing this tracker)
- [ ] **N2 (P2)** PR397 squash merge commit author is `BradleyGleavePortfolio <bradleyapple1031@gmail.com>`, not canonical `Bradley Gleave <bradley@bradleytgpcoaching.com>` per R74 — merge commit `592fc39ebb965c4fbfe995aecbc418433f88f1fe` — fix: do not rewrite merged history; document the historical identity defect here and enforce canonical R74 identity on all follow-up fix PR commits and the final squash metadata

## Already resolved
Pre-merge audit + post-merge re-audit complete. Findings list above is verified against current `main`.
